title: Studios refused to photograph Killian and Peanuts Holland
summary: In Freddy Steps Out and Idea Girl studios used white stand-ins for Black sidemen Al Killian and Peanuts Holland, though their playing was recorded.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: What did you -- is the band in it?
Yeah, the band is in it, although they
refused -- Al Killian was in the band and they wouldn't let him be photographed.
They photographed the rest of the band?
Well, Peanuts Holland was in the band also, and they wouldn't allow either one of them to be photographed.
So what did they do, did they put somebody else --

They put a ringer in for the actual picture. They made the recording, but -- well, this also was true at Universal there, that one picture there, the tune called, "Xango," X-a-n-g-o, was definitely Al Killian's trumpet that's featured all the way through it, and they wouldn't photograph him.
